# Florist trial

Trial bouquet with Bloom and Tide, the florist on the shortlist for the wedding.

- Day: Thursday 22 October, 4 pm, at their studio on Calder Row.
- Bring: the colour card with the blush and sage swatches.
- Cost of the trial: 60 pounds, taken off the final bill if we book.
- Ask: whether they can do table posies in brass jars.
